title: Vacuum gripper and method for operating a vacuum gripper

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum gripper with a suction element and wear detection, but does not describe a housing with a hollow grip portion.

features.item: An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.quote: Vacuum grippers are used for gripping objects by means of negative pressure and are used, for example, as end effectors in vacuum handling systems.
features.note: The reference mentions vacuum grippers use negative pressure for gripping, implying a vacuum generating device, but does not explicitly state it is electrically operated or located in a housing.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: The reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a hollow grip portion.

features.item: A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-damping device or a grip portion.

features.item: A suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to the carrier plate extending around it
features.quote: They usually comprise at least one suction element, which delimits an inner suction compartment and comprises a contact section or alternatively a sealing lip for laying up against an object to be gripped.
features.note: The reference describes a suction element with a sealing lip, which is analogous to a seal, but does not explicitly mention a carrier plate.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip unit with these specific features.

features.item: Vacuum handling apparatus with suction plate and grip unit combined
features.quote: The invention relates to a vacuum gripper comprising a suction element and a wear detection device for detecting a state of wear of the suction element.
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum gripper with a suction element, which is part of a vacuum handling apparatus, but does not explicitly describe a separate 'grip unit' combined with a 'suction plate'.

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip portion or any sound-damping material.

features.item: Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.note: The reference implies a vacuum generating device but does not describe its arrangement within specific housing portions.

features.item: Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-reducing devices or housing portions lined with such material.

features.item: Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip portion or its arrangement between housing portions with an air outlet.

features.item: Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
features.note: The reference does not describe an air collection screw or a grip portion.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
features.note: The reference does not describe air baffles or a grip portion.

features.item: Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
features.note: The reference does not describe a battery coupling point or air baffles.

features.item: Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum gripper with a suction element but does not mention a separate grip unit or a releasable connection to a suction plate.

features.item: Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate
features.quote: In the example shown in FIG. 1 b , the fluid channel 24 in the open state opens into an inner suction compartment of the suction element 12 comprising the negative pressure channels 16 .
features.note: The reference describes a fluid channel opening into an inner suction compartment (suction chamber), but does not explicitly describe a 'grip unit' with a suction opening fluidically connected to it.
